scope: Actual network.js evaluated in Node VM with mocked RTCPeerConnection, timers and transfer cancellation; not browser, NAT or full-suite verification.
passed_tests: ICE/SDP arriving before discovery waits for the authorized peer and preserves order
early signals have a bounded lifetime and budget and clear when a room is left
only selected non-relay paths count as direct; nomination alone cannot prove selection
TURN configuration is rejected; STUN can be explicitly disabled
closing a transport clears previously verified direct status
ICE failure revokes directness and consent on the non-offerer
a pre-disconnect stats result cannot authorize the recovered transport
a late stats success cannot overwrite a terminal failure
older stats cannot overwrite a newer unverified route
a current stats failure revokes previous authorization instead of retaining it
ICE checking revokes the old route and cancels the in-progress file
DTLS transport failure is not hidden by a connected ICE state
remote renegotiation invalidates the route before awaiting SDP processing
a pending fingerprint digest cannot publish after the peer closes
duplicate failure notifications do not consume separate restart attempts
fresh remote renegotiation recovers a failed callee without restoring consent
verify checks current transport health rather than a stale direct flag
a valid current sample records directness but never auto-confirms identity
a currently selected relay is still rejected and closes the peer
stats are not sampled from an SDP negotiation still in progress
duplicate callee failures cannot extend the remote recovery deadline
repeated missing-path samples cannot extend the verification deadline
an old fingerprint digest cannot overwrite the code from a newer negotiation
closing during createOffer prevents a late SDP from entering signaling
both browser failure callbacks still produce only one outstanding restart
release_status: Draft PR only; cross-connection file resume is not implemented.
